say:4:1320718001:1.text: Phew... thanks. I feel loads better now.
say:4:1320718001:1.source_cn: 呼……谢谢你，我感觉好多了。
say:4:1320718001:1.male: Phew... thanks. I feel loads better now.
say:4:1320718001:1.female: Phew... thanks. I feel loads better now.

say:5:1320718002:1.text: That flavor... it was terrifying, even worse than a Hypogean. For a moment, I swear I saw Misarte...
say:5:1320718002:1.source_cn: 真是可怕的味道……比恶魔还吓人。刚才，我迷迷糊糊的，仿...
say:5:1320718002:1.male: That flavor... it was terrifying, even worse than a Hypogean. For a moment, I swear I saw Misarte...
say:5:1320718002:1.female: That flavor... it was terrifying, even worse than a Hypogean. For a moment, I swear I saw Misarte...

say:6:1320718003:0.text: She was saying something, but my head was spinning so much I couldn't make out a word... What kind of Windwhisperer am I, missing a divine message?!
say:6:1320718003:0.source_cn: 她好像和我说话了，但我脑袋发晕，什么都没听清……身为风...
say:6:1320718003:0.male: She was saying something, but my head was spinning so much I couldn't make out a word... What kind of Windwhisperer am I, missing a divine message?!
say:6:1320718003:0.female: She was saying something, but my head was spinning so much I couldn't make out a word... What kind of Windwhisperer am I, missing a divine message?!

choice_prompt:7:1320718003.text: She was saying something, but my head was spinning so much I couldn't make out a word... What kind of Windwhisperer am I, missing a divine message?!
choice_prompt:7:1320718003.source_cn: 她好像和我说话了，但我脑袋发晕，什么都没听清……身为风语者居然没听清神谕，这也太丢人了！
choice_prompt:7:1320718003.male: She was saying something, but my head was spinning so much I couldn't make out a word... What kind of Windwhisperer am I, missing a divine message?!
choice_prompt:7:1320718003.female: She was saying something, but my head was spinning so much I couldn't make out a word... What kind of Windwhisperer am I, missing a divine message?!

say:8:1320718004:1.text: If that's the case, I'm totally rubbing it in Eironn's face!
say:8:1320718004:1.source_cn: 如果是这样，我可得向埃隆好好炫耀一番！
say:8:1320718004:1.male: If that's the case, I'm totally rubbing it in Eironn's face!
say:8:1320718004:1.female: If that's the case, I'm totally rubbing it in Eironn's face!

say:9:1320718006:1.text: Ah... the breeze here feels incredible.
say:9:1320718006:1.source_cn: 啊……话说回来，这里的风，好舒服。
say:9:1320718006:1.male: Ah... the breeze here feels incredible.
say:9:1320718006:1.female: Ah... the breeze here feels incredible.

say:10:1320718007:1.text: You know, the first time I stumbled on this sea of flowers, I wanted to write you a letter describing how breathtaking it is.
say:10:1320718007:1.source_cn: 第一次看到这片花海时我就想写信给你，向你描述这片美景。
say:10:1320718007:1.male: You know, the first time I stumbled on this sea of flowers, I wanted to write you a letter describing how breathtaking it is.
say:10:1320718007:1.female: You know, the first time I stumbled on this sea of flowers, I wanted to write you a letter describing how breathtaking it is.

say:11:1320718008:1.text: But, well, for all my so-called eloquence, I just couldn't put it into words. So… I gave up.
say:11:1320718008:1.source_cn: 我自认为能说会道，却无法描绘出这份景色，最后只好放弃了！
say:11:1320718008:1.male: But, well, for all my so-called eloquence, I just couldn't put it into words. So… I gave up.
say:11:1320718008:1.female: But, well, for all my so-called eloquence, I just couldn't put it into words. So… I gave up.

say:12:1320718009:1.text: Some things, though, you have to see with your own eyes to really understand.
say:12:1320718009:1.source_cn: 有些景色，还是要亲眼所见才能感受它的美好。
say:12:1320718009:1.male: Some things, though, you have to see with your own eyes to really understand.
say:12:1320718009:1.female: Some things, though, you have to see with your own eyes to really understand.

say:13:1320718010:1.text: And the people you share those moments with? That's what makes them unforgettable.
say:13:1320718010:1.source_cn: 而且，一起看风景的人，也会影响欣赏风景的心情。
say:13:1320718010:1.male: And the people you share those moments with? That's what makes them unforgettable.
say:13:1320718010:1.female: And the people you share those moments with? That's what makes them unforgettable.

say:17:1320718016:1.text: You know what this moment needs? Music! You can't waste scenery this gorgeous without a tune.
say:17:1320718016:1.source_cn: 这时候得配上一点音乐，不能辜负了美景。
say:17:1320718016:1.male: You know what this moment needs? Music! You can't waste scenery this gorgeous without a tune.
say:17:1320718016:1.female: You know what this moment needs? Music! You can't waste scenery this gorgeous without a tune.

say:18:1320718017:1.source_cn: 我有些灵感，来，你坐在这里，坐好了。

say:19:1320718018:1.text: It's been a while since I've played, so if I mess up, no laughing, alright?
say:19:1320718018:1.source_cn: 有段时间没弹了，要是有些走调，你可不要笑我。
say:19:1320718018:1.male: It's been a while since I've played, so if I mess up, no laughing, alright?
say:19:1320718018:1.female: It's been a while since I've played, so if I mess up, no laughing, alright?

narration:26:1320718101:0.text: Lorsan gently strums his lute, and a peaceful melody flows through the sea of flowers.
narration:26:1320718101:0.source_cn: 洛桑轻轻拨动了琴弦，悠扬的旋律在盛开的花海间荡漾
narration:26:1320718101:0.male: Lorsan gently strums his lute, and a peaceful melody flows through the sea of flowers.
narration:26:1320718101:0.female: Lorsan gently strums his lute, and a peaceful melody flows through the sea of flowers.

narration:27:1320718102:0.text: You feel your body grow lighter, as though you've become one with the petals dancing freely in the wind.
narration:27:1320718102:0.source_cn: 你感到身体都变得轻盈了不少，如同随风飘扬的花瓣
narration:27:1320718102:0.male: You feel your body grow lighter, as though you've become one with the petals dancing freely in the wind.
narration:27:1320718102:0.female: You feel your body grow lighter, as though you've become one with the petals dancing freely in the wind.

narration:28:1320718103:0.text: Seeing how much you enjoy the melody, Lorsan smiles as well.
narration:28:1320718103:0.source_cn: 见你很喜欢这首曲子，洛桑也露出了笑容
narration:28:1320718103:0.male: Seeing how much you enjoy the melody, Lorsan smiles as well.
narration:28:1320718103:0.female: Seeing how much you enjoy the melody, Lorsan smiles as well.

say:33:1320718104:0.text: Before long, you'll be setting off on your next journey, and perhaps, with a little more saved, I'll leave this place too.
say:33:1320718104:0.source_cn: 不久之后，也许你又要踏上新的旅途，我再存一点旅费也会离...
say:33:1320718104:0.male: Before long, you'll be setting off on your next journey, and perhaps, with a little more saved, I'll leave this place too.
say:33:1320718104:0.female: Before long, you'll be setting off on your next journey, and perhaps, with a little more saved, I'll leave this place too.

say:34:1320718105:0.text: One day, if fate brings us together again somewhere in Esperia, I'll play this melody for you once more.
say:34:1320718105:0.source_cn: 某天，我们在伊索米亚的某个地方再度相遇时，我再为你弹奏...
say:34:1320718105:0.male: One day, if fate brings us together again somewhere in Esperia, I'll play this melody for you once more.
say:34:1320718105:0.female: One day, if fate brings us together again somewhere in Esperia, I'll play this melody for you once more.

say:35:1320718106:1.text: Alright, it's getting late. If we don't head back soon, Gerda's gonna think we got lost or something.
say:35:1320718106:1.source_cn: 好啦，时候不早了，再不回去的话，格尔达该着急了。
say:35:1320718106:1.male: Alright, it's getting late. If we don't head back soon, Gerda's gonna think we got lost or something.
say:35:1320718106:1.female: Alright, it's getting late. If we don't head back soon, Gerda's gonna think we got lost or something.

say:40:1320718109:1.text: Ahh! That melody must've attracted some monsters! Help!!
say:40:1320718109:1.source_cn: 噫！刚才的旋律把那些怪物引过来了！救救救救命！
say:40:1320718109:1.male: Ahh! That melody must've attracted some monsters! Help!!
say:40:1320718109:1.female: Ahh! That melody must've attracted some monsters! Help!!

narration:42:13020731:0.text: Admiring the beautiful scenery of the Petalia Plains, Lorsan is inspired and takes out his lute to play a wonderous piece of music for you.
narration:42:13020731:0.source_cn: 欣赏着繁花原野的美丽风景，洛桑灵感泉涌，拿出琴为你演奏...

narration:43:13020731:0.text: Admiring the beautiful scenery of the Petalia Plains, Lorsan is inspired and takes out his lute to play a wonderous piece of music for you.
narration:43:13020731:0.source_cn: 欣赏着繁花原野的美丽风景，洛桑灵感泉涌，拿出琴为你演奏...

say:44:1320718013:1.text: If only we hadn't cracked open that can of fish...
say:44:1320718013:1.source_cn: 要是没打开过那个鱼罐头就好了……
say:44:1320718013:1.male: If only we hadn't cracked open that can of fish...
say:44:1320718013:1.female: If only we hadn't cracked open that can of fish...

say:45:1320718014:1.text: But then... I wouldn't be here with you.
say:45:1320718014:1.source_cn: 但那样的话，我可能也不会和你一起到这里来。
say:45:1320718014:1.male: But then... I wouldn't be here with you.
say:45:1320718014:1.female: But then... I wouldn't be here with you.

say:46:1320718015:1.text: Guess I should be thanking the fish for this moment.
say:46:1320718015:1.male: Guess I should be thanking the fish for this moment.
say:46:1320718015:1.female: Guess I should be thanking the fish for this moment.

say:47:1320718005:1.text: Hey! Master Arden says true genius can sometimes look foolish. Who's to say I'm not secretly a genius?
say:47:1320718005:1.source_cn: 雅顿老爷子常说，聪明到了极致便显得有些愚蠢，说不定我也...
say:47:1320718005:1.male: Hey! Master Arden says true genius can sometimes look foolish. Who's to say I'm not secretly a genius?
say:47:1320718005:1.female: Hey! Master Arden says true genius can sometimes look foolish. Who's to say I'm not secretly a genius?
